name: Account lost, hacked or family-plan access
model_suggested_name: Locked out of account, family-plan access issues
model_description: Customers report being unable to get into their Spotify account or manage family-plan access, including verification and recovery problems.

name: Login, logout and password problems
model_suggested_name: Password rejected and login failures
model_description: Customers report that Spotify does not accept their password or fails to log them in.

name: Other billing complaints
model_suggested_name: Miscellaneous billing and restriction complaints
model_description: Users report general frustration with app restrictions and a hostile, off-topic complaint that does not describe a specific billing problem.

name: Features locked behind Premium (skips, song choice, playback)
model_suggested_name: Basic playback features locked behind Premium
model_description: Free users say skipping, choosing songs, and other basic playback features were restricted to paying Premium subscribers after an update.

name: Other catalog complaints
model_suggested_name: Songs and music genres missing from catalog
model_description: Customers report that many songs and certain genres, such as gospel music, are not available in the catalog.

name: Lyrics missing or broken
model_suggested_name: Lyrics inconsistently missing or not displayed
model_description: Customers report that lyrics fail to show for some songs while appearing for others, making the feature unreliable.

name: Recommendations, repeats and smart features
model_suggested_name: Unwanted recommendations and suggestions
model_description: Customers are frustrated by excessive or unwanted song recommendations appearing in the app.

name: Other download problems
model_suggested_name: Background song downloads stall until app opened
model_description: Customers report that song downloads get stuck in the background and only resume when they reopen Spotify.

name: Offline mode not working
model_suggested_name: Offline mode fails to work
model_description: Customers report that offline mode does not function as expected when they try to use it.

name: Boycott / political protest with a complaint or departure
model_suggested_name: Boycott over Quran burning and Swedish politics
model_description: Customers say they are uninstalling Spotify and boycotting it in protest over Quran burnings linked to Sweden.

name: General dissatisfaction, no specific product issue
model_suggested_name: Vague dissatisfaction after recent updates
model_description: Customers express general dislike of the app or recent updates without naming any specific product problem.

name: Connection, Bluetooth, car and devices
model_suggested_name: Cannot connect over Wi-Fi; poor audio quality
model_description: Customers report the app fails to connect to the internet over Wi-Fi (working only on mobile data) and that some songs sound poor in quality.

name: App crashes / won't open
model_suggested_name: App crashes or fails to open after update
model_description: Customers report the app crashes or won't open after a recent update.

name: Other playback problems (bugs, not working)
model_suggested_name: Cannot skip back a few seconds in tracks
model_description: Customers report they cannot rewind or go back a few seconds within a song during playback.

name: Lag, slowness, battery and loading
model_suggested_name: App stuck on loading or logo screen
model_description: Customers report the app hangs on its loading or logo screen and never finishes starting.

name: Music stops, pauses or cuts out
model_suggested_name: Music stops halfway and loses playback position
model_description: Customers report playback stops partway through songs and does not resume where it left off, starting a different song instead.

name: Songs won't play / app not working / bugs
model_suggested_name: Songs won't play, features broken, bugs after update
model_description: Customers report songs fail to play, features like volume adjustment, repeat, and voice assistant control do not work after the update.

name: Customer support contact and response
model_suggested_name: Rude and hostile customer support staff
model_description: The customer says the app's support staff were rude, and the review includes an unrelated, offensive remark about LGBTQ users.

name: Ad frequency, length and loudness
model_suggested_name: Excessive ad frequency and loudness for free users
model_description: Free-tier users report too many ads that are loud and interrupt listening.

name: Other usability complaints
model_suggested_name: Too many ads interrupting free music playback
model_description: Free-tier users say ads are excessive and play instead of songs, making the app frustrating.

name: Playlist, queue and library management
model_suggested_name: Cannot skip through long playlists efficiently
model_description: Users find playlists cumbersome to get through, with limited skips making it hard to reach a single desired song.

name: New update / redesign / navigation and layout
model_suggested_name: Disliked redesign, removed features and homescreen layout
model_description: Users feel recent updates removed basic music player features and replaced the homescreen with a scroll-heavy, social-feed style layout they find unusable.
